title: 女生很多时候不是被你说服的，是被你“状态”影响的

timeline.summary: A prompt asks how to cultivate strong behavioral cues; he defines attraction through that concept and asks why some people seem naturally successful with women.
He attributes apparently natural success to upbringing, environment and other lifelong influences that produced what he calls strong behavioral cues.
He says an attractive man may mistakenly credit looks alone, then argues that some handsome men still lack attraction.
He contrasts this with a person he labels weak and unattractive, arguing that such a person may wrongly blame every failure on looks rather than also considering behavior.
